_doc:
Page section registry. Each key is a page; its value is the ordered list of sections rendered by NT_Section_Renderer (src/Sections/). Section keys: component (required, components/<component>.php), key (optional show/hide via sections.json), header (optional, merges page_headers.json[<name>] as args - use with parts/page_header or movie-header/header), args (optional extra context). Add/re-order/remove a section here - no PHP change.

'home' and 'history' are section-structure scaffolds, mapped section-by-section from some_styles/canehouse/priority/sugarcane (home_mobile.jpeg / history_mobile.jpeg): entries pointing at a real component use content that already exists in admin/data/*.json; entries using 'parts/section-placeholder' mark a section the reference design shows that has no ready component/content yet (component name + note = what will render there once its JSON content is authored). Swap a placeholder line for the real component entry when its content is ready - nothing else on the page needs to change.
